description: Settlement of outstanding payments in respect of medical supplies procured from the State Pharmaceuticals Corporation for the period of 2008 - 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Medical Supplies Division purchases medicines and other medical supplies required by hospitals and health institutions across the island from the State Pharmaceuticals Corporation, the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation and local manufacturers and thereafter stores and distribute them. Although payments have been made up to 2023 12 31 from the provisions annually allocated by the General Treasury to the Ministry of Health and Mass Media for such payments, the State Pharmaceuticals Corporation has informed the Ministry of Health and Mass Media on several occasions that there is an outstanding amount of Rs.32.92 billion to be further settled to the Corporation for the period from 2008 to 2023. This matter has arisen at a 2026 budget discussion chaired by the Hon. President and upon the instructions given at the said discussion; matters have been examined, headed by the Department of Public Enterprises, on the payments to be settled. Accordingly, it has been confirmed that Rs.23.87 billion is to be paid from 2018 01 01 to 2023 12 31. Similarly, the amount to be settled from 2008 01 01 to 2017 12 31 is being calculated. Accordingly, taking into account the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media, the Cabinet has approved the payment of Rs.23.87 billion for the period from 2018 01 01 to 2023 12 31 in a phased out manner, during this year.
